prompt.en: Besides federal and provincial policing, what other policing work does the RCMP do?
prompt.fr: En plus du travail policier fédéral et provincial, quel autre travail policier la GRC accomplit-elle?

options.en: It is the police force in some municipalities.
options.fr: Elle est le corps de police de certaines municipalités.

explanation.en: Some municipalities are policed by the RCMP as well.
explanation.fr: Certaines municipalités sont aussi desservies par la GRC.

source.quote: serve as the provincial police in all provinces and territories except Ontario and Quebec, as well as in some municipalities.
